verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage has its own transaction API. You submit transactions directly to it for payment screening and transaction monitoring, so the product does not run on any one processor's rails. However, the evidence never states that it works across multiple PSPs, gateways or platforms; processor independence is only implied by this standalone API design. missing for 10: explicit documentation of PSP/gateway/platform-agnostic support, named integrations or connectors for multiple processors, guidance on normalizing transaction data from different payment stacks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use the product across whatever payment stack I run — multiple PSPs, gateways, and platforms — rather than being locked to one processor's rails

citations.quote: Creates a transaction and executes our payment screening and transaction monitoring processes.
The schema documents customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources.
